lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: That your ship on pad six? It turns like a warehouse, but I could work with it.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: You are volunteering to fly my warehouse?

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Ten crates buys the answer. I fly, you keep fuel in it, and nobody uses the word brakes.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Done. First rule: if I say hold on, find something structural.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Your loss. Probably your hull too, eventually.
